title: Eval result (one fixture, one run)
description: The OUTPUT record for a single fixture run through both arms. Captures each arm's Tier-0 deterministic verdict, the blind position-randomized pairwise judge panel output (per-dimension winner+margin, overall, panel votes), and the A/B<->arm blinding map for audit. One such object per line in a results JSONL.

fixture.description: Fixture id this result is for; joins back to the fixture file stem.

run.description: Run identifier — distinguishes repeated runs of the same fixture (e.g. a timestamp or corpus-run id).

output_type.description: Copied from the fixture so the aggregator can bucket by output type without re-reading fixtures.

commit.description: Optional git commit the run was produced against, for provenance.

ts.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp of the run.

deterministic.description: Tier-0 deterministic verdict per arm. Recorded for BOTH arms even when the check gates one of them out.

judge.description: Blind pairwise judge panel output. Judges saw neutral labels A/B only; the A<->arm mapping is in blinding_map, NOT visible to judges.

per_dimension.description: One panel-aggregated verdict per rubric dimension.

panel_votes.description: Number of independent judges in the panel (e.g. 3). Aggregation is median/majority over this many votes.

blinding_map.description: Audit record of which neutral judge label corresponded to which arm for THIS run. Position is randomized per run, so this is the only way to de-blind results.

armName.description: The two arms by canonical name.

pass.description: True iff the Tier-0 checker exited 0 for this arm's artifact.

check.description: Optional checker kind that produced this verdict (mirrors fixture.deterministic_check.kind).

note.description: Optional one-line checker stdout / failure reason.

winner.description: Blind winner in A/B terms. De-blind via blinding_map. 'tie' is recorded, never broken.

margin.description: Strength of the win, 0..1 normalized. 0 for a tie. Aggregated from per-judge margins.

dimension.description: Rubric dimension key this verdict scores; joins to fixture.rubric.dimensions[].key.

winner.description: Panel-aggregated blind winner for this dimension.

margin.description: Normalized 0..1 margin for this dimension; 0 for a tie.
